description: The Buddy list client's Search and Media windows (decision 15). They draw their own title bars, so they may move, minimize, maximize and close themselves; they open links and hand downloads to the person's browser; and interface size zooms the page and grows the window to match (core/appearance.ts). Of the app's own commands (build.rs) they may call only graphics_started, the start-up check every window runs: they ask the server themselves with the list window's lent sign-in, and everything else stays the list window's.
